sources.snippet: mobilenet-v2-1.-224 is one of MobileNet models, which are small, low-latency, low-power, and parameterized to meet the resource constraints of a variety of use cases. They can be used for classification, detection, embeddings, and segmentation like other popular large-scale models. For details, see the paper.
